Using the ratio:
\[
\frac{f(n+1)}{f(n)}=\frac{(n+1)^2/n^2}{1.001}=\frac{(1+1/n)^2}{1.001}.
\]
The sequence increases while
\[
(1+1/n)^2>1.001 \iff 1+\frac1n>\sqrt{1.001}.
\]
Since \(\sqrt{1.001}\approx 1.000499875\), this holds for
\[
n<\frac{1}{\sqrt{1.001}-1}\approx 2000.5.
\]
Thus \(f(2001)>f(2000)\), but \(f(2002)<f(2001)\). The maximum occurs at \(n=2001\).

\[
\boxed{2001}
\]
